title: docs(skills): scope "Declaring is a demand" to what os serve does

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1XdbbGasMNVx41tq3hZKV4)_

Fixes #35285

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-platform` 技能里「Declaring is a demand」一条,从"凡是声明了而缺 provider 都是启动硬错误"改成按 `os serve` 的真实行为分两类:provider 表里的 token 与 `ai`/`ai-studio` 缺包即启动失败;企业版/云端 token(`hierarchy-security` 等)缺 provider 只告警、照常启动,`hierarchy-security` 的层级范围随后退化为仅本人。
- 为什么改:旧句会让 agent 告诉用户"应用会拒绝启动",实际却以更窄的可见性正常启动;反过来也会把一次干净启动误读成层级范围已生效。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文案 + token 棘轮一行上调 18;回滚即 revert 本 PR,无运行时影响。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 第 331-335 行(改写的规则);`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 平台行注释(6145 -> 6163 的算账);`.changeset/35285-platform-declared-capability-boot.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期平台行打印 `6163 tokens (ceiling 6163; headroom 0)` 且整体通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(`skills/**` 受管,需席位契约评审记录)。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, the "Declaring is a demand" rule under `requires:`. Before: any capability the app declared whose provider package is absent is a hard boot error. After: a declared token of the provider table, or `ai` / `ai-studio`, with its package absent is a hard boot error; one the platform auto-injects stays best-effort; a declared enterprise / cloud token with no provider only warns at boot, and `hierarchy-security`'s scopes then fall back to owner-only.

What `os serve` does, read at `origin/main` `f848e373`:

- Declared `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` token, provider import fails: throws `missingProviderMessage(cap)` (module not found) or `Capability ... failed to start` (crash); the outer boot catch exits 1. `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:5608-5628`. The same token auto-injected (not in `declaredRequires`) only warns or logs and the boot goes on: `serve.ts:5629-5633`.
- Declared `ai` / `ai-studio`: `resolveAiServiceLoad` answers `required` (`packages/cli/src/utils/ai-service-auto-inject.ts:57-70`), and `loadOptionalServicePlugin` throws for a required load whose package is absent or crashes (`serve.ts:5311-5342`, called at `:5374-5378` and `:5395-5405`).
- Declared known token with no `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` row and no tier, which is `hierarchy-security` and the cloud-only `ai-seat`, `governance`, `audit-compliance`, `access-policy-console`: `judgeDeclaredCapabilities` (`packages/cli/src/utils/capability-preflight.ts:413-432`) and every finding is printed with `console.warn`; the code comment says "A warning, never a refusal: the boot is unchanged" (`serve.ts:5472-5497`). The resolver loop then `continue`s past these tokens silently (`serve.ts:5499-5531`).
- With no hierarchy resolver mounted, the sharing layer answers owner-only for the hierarchy-relative scopes: `if (!resolver) return [me];` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts:2470-2477`).

Prior rulings read before writing, as the claim named: ADR-0116 Decision (D1-D5, plugin ordering and init-service requirements) and ADR-0120 D5 (uniqueness authoring gates). Neither says a declared capability provider must always be a hard boot error, so the skill is scoped to the code, not the other way round.

Paid for under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068, letter B). Two restatements cut first, each keeping its other home in the same sentence:

- ", not at boot" after "rejected by `defineStack` at authoring time".
- "— so new routes added to HttpDispatcher work automatically" after "`createHonoApp` ... delegates everything else to it".

The platform row of `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` moves by the measured remainder only, with its arithmetic note.

## Tests

No code changes; the gates below are the evidence.

Published-skills readings (`skills/**`):

- Edited file, whole-file lines: 421 -> 422. Tokens (ratchet convention, stamp line excluded): 6145 -> 6163 (priced bytes 24577 -> 24649: cuts -78, rule +150).
- Whole package, all `skills/*/SKILL.md` summed: 4830 -> 4831 lines. Bundle total (whole shipped tree, ratchet report): 269946 -> 269964 tokens.

## Acceptance notes

- The "Declaring is a demand" sentence names the tier-gated tokens it covers (`ai` / `ai-studio`) and leaves `i18n`, `ui` and `auth` unsaid: their blocks take no `requires` intent (`serve.ts:4016-4048` warns on a missing `@objectstack/service-i18n` whether or not declared). Not a claim this PR makes either way.
- A declared `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` token whose package loads but does not export its class only warns (`serve.ts:5538-5541`), unlike the tier loader, which throws for a required load (`serve.ts:5319-5323`). Observation only, not filed: no reach measured.
- `check:role-word` reports `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` improved 2 -> 1; its ledger is outside this card's file surface, so `--update` was not run.
